placement_change.why: 2 ads in Prospecting | Salons and clinics | US show small in Stories and Reels (Static | No-shows stat | square, Video | Demo walkthrough | 16:9), but 2 other ads in the same ad set fit them full screen (Reel | Front desk in 20 seconds, Dynamic | Reminders | 4:5 + 9:16). Switching those placements off would take them from every ad in the ad set, and a 9:16 version fixes the cause. No change is offered.
